mesh.verification_scope: Closing-endpoint native lon/lat/nv checked exactly against retained immutable mesh; native surface dimensions checked in every hourly response.

official_model_documentation.relevant_facts: Official documentation states four daily cycles, each with a six-hour nowcast; actual Times in each selected response is authoritative.

selection.product: nowcast only, n001 through n006; no forecast substitution
selection.candidate_mapping: For a cycle c and nowcast index h=1..6, candidate valid time is c-6h+h hours. Every selected actual Times is read and must match; filenames alone do not establish time.

precision: Each official Float32 ASCII surface array is parsed and stored as native Float32; no decimal display rounding, vector rotation, spatial reconstruction or temporal averaging.
river_note: No river-model data changed; static river estimate retains its separate 12 October00:00 to17 October12:00 UTC forcing period.
interpretation: Actual hourly model chronology. Closing19Oct00Z endpoint supports interpolation through the final requested hour. Color scale remains12 to16.5C; physical vector components and independent node temperatures are retained, not invented or averaged.
